ou said:

How do I use it properly the very first time?

08:18 AM

Absolutely. For the first time, keep it simple: plant in full sun, wait until all chance of frost has passed, and sow into soil that drains well.

California Giants Zinnias are easy-going and do not need much water once established. They grow quickly from seed and bloom from summer until frost, so they are a very forgiving beginner choice.

If you want the best start, begin with a small patch so it feels easy to manage.
